source_hierarchy.role: Secondary text witness for sequence/reading comparison

source_notes: The chapter is not merely a 'weights and measures' chapter; it opens with the purpose and scope of the Saṃhitā and then develops pharmaceutical/clinical paribhāṣā.

The digital Sanskrit witness shows verse-number discontinuities in the displayed text around sections; AaptaKosha must preserve source numbering and reconcile missing/displayed-number issues against the base edition before importing verse records.
BharatKosha explicitly identifies the text as a 32-chapter Saṃhitā and gives the traditional total of 2,600 ślokas.
Do not convert traditional māna into modern metric equivalents at the canonical-text layer. Modern equivalents belong only in a separately labelled educational/reference layer.
next_gate: Build the complete Chapter 1 canonical content package (verses 1-61) with Hindi translation, source-attributed Dīpikā commentary mapping, learning units and assessments, then commit the whole chapter as one commit.

canonical_text_witness.evidence: Chapter 1 runs continuously from verse 1 through verse 61 and closes with the Paribhāṣākathanam colophon.

verse_number_reconciliation.note: The opened Wikisource chapter explicitly shows the complete numbered sequence 1-61; the earlier discontinuity was an artifact of compact search extraction.

verse_map.section: पूर्व, मध्य, उत्तर खण्ड अध्यायानुक्रम तथा ग्रन्थसंख्या
मानस्य आवश्यकता तथा मागधमान की सूक्ष्म इकाइयाँ
माष, शाण, टङ्क, कोल, कर्ष तथा पर्याय
पल से खारी/भार/तुला तथा चतुर्गुण मान-क्रम
द्रव/आर्द्र/शुष्क द्रव्य मान, द्विगुण नियम, कुडव पात्र
औषध-प्रयोग में नवीनता, विशिष्ट द्रव्यों की आर्द्रता, द्विगुण ग्रहण
अनुक्तावस्था परिभाषा, पुनरुक्त द्रव्य, चन्दनादि व्यवस्था
रोगानुसार युक्तायुक्त द्रव्य, देशभेद, औषध-संग्रह-विधि तथा कुत्सित स्थान-त्याग
ऋतु अनुसार संग्रह तथा अनुक्त अवयव में ग्राह्य अंग

delivery_contract.canonical_text_policy: Do not silently emend readings. Preserve the verified base witness; record variants separately.
delivery_contract.translation_policy: Hindi translation must be independently authored from the verified Sanskrit and kept separate from source commentary.
delivery_contract.commentary_policy: Do not fabricate Dīpikā/Gūḍhārthadīpikā wording when only bibliographic or secondary access is available.
